Utterance of Marvels: II is the second part in the Prologue chapter of the Main Quests.

Contents

  • 1 Steps
  • 2 Gameplay Notes
  • 3 Dialogue
  • 4 Other Languages
  • 5 Change History
  • 6 Navigation

Steps[]

  1. Find a suitable Tacet Discord
  2. Defeat Stonewall Bracer
  3. Absorb the Reverberation and obtain an Echo
  4. Equip the Echo
  5. Defeat nearby TDs: (0/2)
  6. Return to Jinzhou
    1. (Optional) Activate Resonance Beacon
  7. Head to Jinzhou

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing the quest will grant the Rover's Journey trophy From the New World and Resonator Chixia.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.
Baizhi: It would be best for your well-being to have a thorough physical examination once we arrive in Jinzhou.
Baizhi: While there don't seem to be any immediate side effects following the absorption of that Echo, we cannot rule out the possibility of other latent risks.
Baizhi: Given our lack of data on you and your unusual physical signs, I suggest absorbing another Reverberation with your Terminal when we find one. That being said, please be sure to proceed cautiously.
Chixia: Yeah, don't go too hard on yourself. You should get a check-up just to be safe. Besides, Yangyang's very worried about you.
Yangyang: If you feel any discomfort along the way, please do let us know.

(As the player goes to the designated location)

Chixia: I'm gonna get you one you can absorb. I never go back on my promise! Your hero Chixia's on the hunt!
Baizhi: Can you reenact what you did before?
(Shake your head.)
I feel nothing.
I don't have the feeling of being pushed like I did before.
Chixia: Hmm, maybe you can only absorb the powerful ones with your body?
Chixia: Or does it have to be a certain type of Tacet Discord?
Chixia: Or maybe...
Chixia: Maybe we should give your Terminal a whirl?
Chixia: Yay! it worked!
Chixia: I've never seen a gourd quite like yours before, but it sure is working just fine.
Chixia: Hmm... Your Terminal's got a different look, but the functions are pretty much the same.
Chixia: Look! Jinzhou City's just up ahead!
Yangyang: ...Rover?

Chapter 1 Act 1 Utterance of Marvels [Quest Complete]

???: Hehe, there you are.
???: My dearest...
???: ...seed of fate.
Chixia: Alrighty. What should we do next?
Chixia: Shall we go grab a bite?
Sounds good.
We should visit the City Hall.
I should go get my body check-up.
Let's focus on the task at hand.
Baizhi: I am to return to the Academy.
Baizhi: The anomalies at the Gorges of Spirits, the resurgence of that Tacet Field, and the many Waveworn Phenomena occurrences... I should report them in time.
Yangyang: Then I'll go submit our report, and prepare the documentation needed for Rover's audience with the Magistrate while I'm there.
Documentation?
Yangyang: It's the political hub of Jinzhou, and where the Grand LibraryData Repository is located.
Yangyang: The City Hall is an important place. Seeking an audience with the Magistrate isn't too difficult, but there are still rules to follow.
Sounds like a lot of work.
Yangyang: It may take some time, but there won't be too much paperwork.
What about me?
Okay.
Chixia: Then I guess I'll take Rover over to the Nexus Tower for registration first, and we'll just hang out for a while.
Chixia: Being new to Jinzhou and all, (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍) can't be left standing outside the City Hall with nothing to do.
Chixia: Hospitality is our local speciality, you know!
Yangyang: Then I'll leave you in Chixia's care, Rover. Is that alright with you? I'll give you a call once the paperwork is done.
Chixia: Leave it to me!
Baizhi: I'll send the Branch of Resonmedical Science a notice. We need to conduct a throughout physical examination on you to make sure you are fine.
Baizhi: Come visit the Academy after your audience if you have no other plans.
A thorough examination?
Baizhi: Yes. A physical examination would be required to determine if any disease is present. If no medical issues are found, we'll conduct further monitoring and analysis to understand what happened to your body.
Baizhi: Of course, we won't do anything without your consent.
The Academy?
Baizhi: The unique nature of your condition requires specialized treatment only available in the Huaxu Academy.
Baizhi: And your body is bound to arouse the interest of many researchers.
Baizhi: Myself included.
Yangyang: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...
Baizhi: I see. I agree that my phrasing lacked the attention to detail. Please allow me to reorganize my words.
Sure.
Chixia: You guys done yet?
Chixia: What's the hold up. Let's move, then I'll have more time to show Rover around!
Chixia: We've got loads of fun in Jinzhou! We can go watch Liondances, Hero Plays, Stand-up Shows, and then maybe the Martial Championships... Plus tons of different treats to try out. You think it, we have it.
Let's go.
Let's split up.
Yangyang, Baizhi, see you later.

(Cutscene plays) (Cutscene ends)
